content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00029, SRS_Rte_00082, SRS_Rte_00312 The RTE Implementation Plug-In shall ignore the received responseSignal if multiple clients are connected to this responseSignal, the Client Server Communication Graph is handled by the RTE Implementation Plug-In and no valid transaction handle could be retrieved (e.g. due to a transformer hard error or the RTE not being able to allocate the buffer to transform the data).
